cpu_frequency.policy: diagnostic-only: scaling_cur_freq is sampled but never gates, excludes, or normalizes an observation

manifest.thermal_rationale: predeclared before formal observations after a full-parameter paired smoke rose from 59.125C to 93.625C; runtime invalidation remains 95C

schedule_design.independent_unit: one fresh child process containing one paired default/explicit-empty observation
schedule_design.within_process_measurement: approximately 100 ms batches in repeating ABBA cycles derived from the requested initial order
schedule_design.initial_order_counterbalance: phase=(floor(round/2)+floor(round/workload_count))%2; first_side_first=(slot+phase)%2==0; 10 AB and 10 BA processes per workload
schedule_design.frequency_policy: diagnostic samples only; no observation is excluded, gated, or normalized by frequency

benchmark_contract.status: canonical paired binary validated against the version-1 receipt contract and frozen by commit and SHA-256
benchmark_contract.measurement_unit: one child emits one common-process paired receipt

design_caveats: The paired benchmark source is frozen at candidate commit 812616652cbf05470f963e4238260e9ca5d9d38a and the runner verifies its release binary hash before and after the campaign.
ABBA batch cycles reduce between-process state noise but can introduce cache, allocator, and GC carryover; balanced initial order mitigates rather than eliminates it.
Only the 20 fresh-process ratios per workload are independent statistical units; interleaved batches within a child are not independent samples.
The GNU task CPU-share audit covers the whole paired child and cannot identify an interruption confined to one configuration.
A full-parameter smoke rose from 59.125C to 93.625C, so the formal policy is frozen at 60C admission/start, 180s cooldown, and the unchanged 95C runtime invalidation threshold.
scaling_cur_freq is a coarse instantaneous sysfs diagnostic, not an APERF/MPERF effective-clock measurement, and never affects validity or acceptance.
The Tctl hwmon index can change across boots; the runner resolves the path by its Tctl label at campaign start.

task_execution_audit.scope: whole taskset child, including common setup, both interleaved measurements, allocation samples, and paired receipt emission

validity.metric: GNU time %P (task user+system CPU time divided by task wall time)
validity.rationale: with all child threads pinned to one logical CPU, a 99% reported task CPU share bounds visible scheduler/preemption loss to about one percent; both sides share the same audited child process
validity.context_switch_policy: voluntary and involuntary counts are recorded for diagnosis but are not gated because switch counts do not measure descheduled duration
